info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Investment Portfolio Update API
info.description: The Investment Portfolio Update API allows financial professionals to make real-time amendments to existing investment portfolios. This API enables users to adjust key attributes such as asset allocation, risk tolerance, and investment goals. Typical consumers include portfolio managers and financial advisors who require a dynamic tool to optimize client investments efficiently. Integrating this API streamlines the investment management process, ensuring portfolios remain aligned with client objectives and market conditions.
